extension.description: Finds commits whose messages match keywords and saves the changed line numbers as JSON plus the changed files before/after each commit, for comparing static analysis warnings.
command.collectCommitChanges.title: Collect Changed Code from GitHub Commits
command.clearRepositoryCache.title: Clear Cached Repository Clones
config.outputDirectory: Folder where results are saved; a subfolder per repository is created inside, holding the result JSON and one folder per commit hash with the changed files before/after the commit. Relative paths are resolved against the first workspace folder. Empty: `<workspace>/warnpriority-output` (or a folder picker when no folder is open).
config.fileExtensions: Only collect changes to files with these extensions. Default: source files of languages that static analyzers support (Java, Kotlin, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP, Ruby, Swift, ...); docs, XML, build files, data and images are never collected. Set `["java"]` to collect Java files only. An empty list means the default.
config.maxCommits: Maximum number of matching commits to collect (newest first). `0`: no limit.
config.useRegex: Treat keywords as POSIX extended regular expressions (e.g. `\bfix(e[sd])?\b`) instead of plain text.
config.includeMergeCommits: Also collect merge commits (diffed against their first parent). Requires Git 2.31+.
config.ignoreWhitespace: Ignore changes that only touch whitespace.
config.gitPath: Path to the Git executable. Empty: the Git used by VS Code's Git extension, or `git` on PATH.
command.runPmd.title: Analyze Collected Results with PMD
config.pmd.ruleset: PMD rules to run. `all` (default): every rule of PMD's eight Java categories (best practices, code style, design, documentation, error prone, multithreading, performance, security; about 300 rules). Otherwise a ruleset such as `rulesets/java/quickstart.xml` (PMD's recommended set), categories such as `category/java/errorprone.xml,category/java/bestpractices.xml`, or the path of your own ruleset XML, separated by commas.
config.pmd.home: Folder of an unpacked PMD 7 distribution (containing `lib/`) to use instead of the PMD that WarnPriority downloads from Maven Central.
config.pmd.java: Java executable used to run PMD (Java 8 or newer). Empty: `JAVA_HOME`, then the JDK of VS Code's Java extension (`java.jdt.ls.java.home`), then `java` on PATH.
